question: Under a fixed sidewalk segmentation protocol, is CA benefit reproducible, and is its behavior associated with implementation details and gate strength?

historical_results_policy.historical_weight_selection: best checkpoint selected by the historical training metric; do not relabel as global-mIoU-best
historical_results_policy.historical_enet_ca_comparison: observational only: different saved optimizer weight decay
historical_results_policy.historical_boundary_columns: preserve, but do not cite columns labeled official as the author's Boundary IoU

data.ignore_label_policy: retain historical all-other-to-background policy in the core comparison; assess ignored-region sensitivity separately
data.sample_order: sort by city and filename before applying a seeded shuffle
data.validation_role: model selection and validation reporting; not an untouched independent test set
data.calibration_data: fixed samples drawn from train only; never validation

metrics.global_confusion: accumulate all pixels over all validation images before computing class IoU
metrics.class_union_zero: IoU is 0, matching the established project convention
metrics.boundary_aggregation: per-image foreground Boundary IoU, then arithmetic mean over nonempty boundary unions
metrics.boundary_both_empty: exclude and report valid and excluded image counts
metrics.old_boundary_method: optional historical reference with an explicit separate name

formal_training.weight_decay_choice: explicitly retain the ENet baseline and most historical independent runs' saved setting for every new variant; not a claim of optimality
formal_training.scheduler_steps: once after each completed epoch; checkpoint saved with a consistent completed-step counter

loss.cross_entropy_implementation: -log_softmax(logits, dim=1).gather(1, target.unsqueeze(1)).mean(); no class weights or label smoothing; mathematically same unweighted pixel mean CE

formal_training.paired_controls: same backbone initialization and explicit data generator ordering per seed; attention initialized separately
formal_training.rng_checkpoint: save and restore Python, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA and data-generator states
formal_training.report: all seeds, per-seed paired changes, mean and standard deviation; do not claim universal failure or statistical significance from three seeds

execution.paired_initialization: CPU default generator in fork_rng; copy ALL common backbone parameters and buffers; attention CPU seed=seed+10000; preserve CUDA dropout RNG
execution.resume: completed epochs only, fresh output directory, reject different code/protocol/data/runtime

candidate_matrix.role: control the effect of simply weakening attenuation
candidate design, not implemented or validated yet

mixed_gate_candidate.E: alpha is sigmoid of a trainable scalar initialized to logit(0.1)
mixed_gate_candidate.fairness: D and E share the same starting gate strength and CA/backbone initialization
mixed_gate_candidate.novelty: a task-specific hypothesis and evaluation; residual/gated attention itself is not claimed as new

execution_order.task: unified evaluation of all 15 existing completed models, into new outputs; U-Net excluded from the main comparison
common runner and implementation correctness checks
fixed-sample attention diagnostics and controlled inference interventions
connect diagnostic evidence to reproducible outcomes
conditional second-backbone or CBR ablation expansion
target-device deployment validation; compatibility can be checked earlier
video prototype and separated local-scene validation

resources.upload_permission: separate authorization required before external model/data upload
resources.electricity: not estimated yet; determine local rate and measured/assumed average power before setting a total training-hours cap if included in the 50 CNY budget

output_policy.record_sources: protocol id, model source hashes, weight hashes, sample file ids and environment versions
output_policy.change_control: changes to fixed conditions require a new protocol revision; do not silently mix revisions

revision.reason: Strict deterministic mode rejects local Torch 2.5.1 CUDA nll_loss2d mean reduction. Use mathematically equivalent unweighted CE from log_softmax, label gather and mean.
